description: This Java source file defines the ThingSupervisorActor class, which manages the lifecycle of ThingPersistenceActor instances, including creation, supervision, restart with exponential back-off, and handling termination scenarios within an Akka actor system.

classes.name: ThingSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for supervising ThingPersistenceActor instances, handling their lifecycle, restarts with exponential back-off, and providing exception handling strategies.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating a ThingSupervisorActor with specified pubSubMediator, distributedPub, and propsFactory.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ThingId entity ID by decoding the actor's self path name.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props for creating a new ThingPersistenceActor for a given entity ID.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Returns the shutdown behavior for a given ThingId, involving pubSubMediator and actor reference.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Builds a ThingUnavailableException for a given ThingId, or a dummy if null.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the exponential back-off configuration for supervisor restarts from system settings.
